note: The reference also claims zstd on Python 3.14 and later. Every case it does not pass, and why; remove an entry when the reference is fixed.

not_passing.reason: Marker values are stripped, so "false " turns stripping off; §10.4 says marker lines are not stripped, which makes the value invalid (§12.4.5).
Without compression.zstd a .zst part is read as plain bytes instead of failing (decision 2).
A carriage return is written raw, not as <CR> (decision 10).
A carriage return is written raw, not as <CR>, in .csvz too (decision 10).
<CR> is not decoded, so a scrub keeps it as text (decision 10).
parts prints the suffix gz instead of the codec name gzip (decision 14).
parts prints the suffix bz2 instead of the codec name bzip2 (decision 14).
